text:
It has to come out.

The first web is in the way. Hung from the second, the crown rises to 9.9 metres, and the first web crosses at 6.7: the dome would pass 3.2 metres up through it. So the dome is handed over first, on long cords from the second web, a corner at a time. Then the first web comes out: the spiral unwound from its outer end, and each rope of the X untied at one tree and pulled through from the other.
